scope: Vulkan matmul compute kernel correctness against a CPU FP32 reference. This is a KERNEL certificate. It does NOT certify Deep2 Layer 0 GPU inference.

defect_1_host_push_constant_order.why: The shader declares its push-constant block as { m, n, k }. The host sent { M, K, N }, which swapped n and k, so the GPU computed a differently-shaped product. This alone caused the previously reported cosine of -0.2647591411.

defect_2_shader_early_return_before_barr.was: if (row >= m || col >= n) return;  // before barrier()
defect_2_shader_early_return_before_barr.now: Out-of-range outputs are guarded at the final store; every invocation reaches both barrier() calls.
defect_2_shader_early_return_before_barr.why: In Vulkan, barrier() must be executed uniformly across the workgroup. Early return makes behaviour undefined, so any dimension that is not a multiple of 16 could hang or produce garbage. Irrelevant at 64x128x96, which is why the first test did not expose it.

environment.note_on_build: The harness build orders the Vulkan SDK Include before the repository include, because include/vulkan/vulkan.h is a stub that shadows the real API. The repository build was not modified.

single_element_attribution.conclusion: All 128 K-dimension contributions are individually attributed and the GPU total matches the CPU total to 4.5e-08, separating a previously-suspected indexing error (now ruled out) from accumulation error.

dual_gpu_result.method: The M dimension is split across two VulkanCompute instances, each pinned to a different physical device index. A row-slice of the row-major A matrix is uploaded per device, dispatched independently, and the two output slices are scattered back into a single combined C.

what_this_does_not_establish: Deep2 Layer 0 GPU inference. ModelGenieExecutor still contains no GPU execution path; every LinearFwd, AttentionFwd, RMSNorm, RoPE and MoE primitive still runs on the CPU.
GPU RoPE. VulkanCompute::ExecuteRoPE remains a placeholder that performs no work.
GPU KV cache, attention, MoE or end-to-end model parity.
remaining_blockers_for_deep2_gpu_layer_0: Remove or rename include/vulkan/vulkan.h so the real Vulkan SDK header is used and src/vulkan_compute.cpp builds against the real API in the main tree.
Implement real GPU RoPE ( ExecuteRoPE is a no-op placeholder ).
Add a GPU execution path into ModelGenieExecutor with explicit backend selection.
Then, and only then, attempt RAWRXD_DEEP2_GPU_LAYER_001 again.

reproduction.dependencies: None new. Uses the installed Vulkan SDK 1.4.357.0 and the existing src/vulkan_compute.cpp plus src/modelgenie sources.
